name: Hoback River — Hwy 189 Bridge to Snake River
blurb: Hoback River: sections between Wyoming Game and Fish Department river access points.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Launch at the Highway 189 Bridge access upstream of Kozy Campground and take out near the Granite Creek mouth on the Hoback. Both markers show approximate access areas; identify usable landings and lawful parking before setting the shuttle. Granite Creek Campground is a different facility.

notices.title: Granite Creek: takeout, not a confirmed launch
notices.text: Granite Creek lies downstream of Kozy Campground. Forest Order 04-03-315 limits launches on National Forest System land from Kozy to the Snake to designated ramps through April 30, 2029. This map uses Granite Creek as a takeout; its designated launch status is unconfirmed.

notices.title: Approximate access areas
notices.text: Identify the usable bank access and lawful parking before launching. These markers locate the agency-listed areas; they do not trace a carry, ramp or bank side. Use the correction link to help pinpoint a landing.

sections.notes: Permission to launch at Granite Creek under the lower Hoback order remains unconfirmed. The public approach and usable landing at Stinking Springs also need confirmation. Check both with the Forest Service before planning this float.
sections.accessReview: Granite Creek designated launch status under the lower Hoback order remains unconfirmed, and the Stinking Springs landing is unresolved. Takeout access at Granite Creek does not approve launching there.

notices.title: Lower Hoback launch restriction
notices.text: From Kozy Campground downstream to the Snake, launches on National Forest System land require a designated ramp under Forest Order 04-03-315 through April 30, 2029. The WGFD inventory alone does not confirm Granite Creek as a designated launch.

sections.notes: Put-in Stinking Springs (Hoback): not mapped (WGFD lists the site but no agency facility coordinate was found within 300 m in WGFD, BLM, USFS or NPS layers). Take-out Spotted Horse Ranch (Hoback): not mapped (WGFD lists the site but no agency facility coordinate was found within 300 m in WGFD, BLM, USFS or NPS layers). Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal. Watercraft entering Wyoming Mar 1–Nov 30 need an AIS inspection. Mileage: preliminary NHDPlus V2 routed geometry (4.1 mi); no agency mileage found.
sections.accessReview: Public approach and designated launch access remain unconfirmed at the unresolved Hoback endpoint. Do not treat the agency inventory marker as permission to launch or cross private land.

notices.title: Lower Hoback launch restriction
notices.text: Forest Order 04-03-315 restricts launching on National Forest System land within one-half mile of the Hoback from Kozy Campground to the Snake, and the Snake from South Park Bridge to the Greys River, to designated ramps. The order runs through April 30, 2029 unless rescinded. It does not grant access across private ranch land; confirm the permitted launch with Bridger-Teton National Forest.
